design: One push-triggered workflow, migration plus three sequential distinct GitHub-hosted jobs. Exact parent ZIP and canonical member digests pinned from R1.4 logs/API; reconstruct R1.4 version3 from original signed envelopes and compare to B snapshot. Export self-contained public checkpoint with registry history, historical signed envelopes and admission times, pending pre-signed test envelopes, snapshot. New synthetic test key enrolled for this run only with registry revision3; revoke previous key in test context. Three automatic job-to-job handoffs using job outputs checkpoint digest and immutable artifact IDs, no manual anchors between jobs. Each job recreates SQLite by re-verifying all historical signed documents, checks parent digest and version, rejects replays and accepts exactly one distinct pre-signed receipt; v3->4->5->6. Final fresh restore check. All outputs staging only.
limits: Three jobs in one workflow are NOT three separate runs or independent observer. Job output anchor within same trust domain, no global rollback resistance. Fixed synthetic clock. No real-time, real external source, persistent keys, live Cortex, production or training. No secrets, no write permissions except artifact service. No self-dispatch, default-branch change or permissions escalation.
gate: Check both archived ZIP hashes and canonical members; reconstruct exact v3; three linked advances with rejection no mutation, all receipt knowledge_admitted false, no private key bytes. Final report from CI only. Independent witness and three distinct automatically triggered runs remain HOLD.
